<!--
  concept — abstract idea or mental model the team leans on (e.g. "activation").
  Lives at: `<domain>/concepts/<kebab-name>.md` — pick the sub-wiki by what the concept must cite, not by who is
    interested in it: a term true regardless of our product is `domain/`, a speculative or cross-cutting product idea
    is `product/`, an interaction or accessibility standard is `design/`, an operational model is `operations/`, and
    governance vocabulary is `governance/`. Shallowest home whose layer covers its citations wins. A cross-cutting
    product policy — a rule the product enforces everywhere rather than one feature's own idea — lives instead at
    `product/concepts/policies/<kebab-name>.md`.
  Authorship: curated. SLO: 365d.
  Distinct from: a committed product capability — use the product `feature` template for that; and
    an enumerated controlled vocabulary the concept is realized as — the members of a governed set
    live in a `catalog`, linked from `## Related concepts`; a concept page states the idea, not its
    roster. This type declares no `## Open questions`, and an unsettled question routes by what it
    is: a caveat qualifying the definition sits with the claim it limits, in `## Definition` or
    `## Usage`; an evidence gap belongs on the `source-summary` for the source it is a gap in, or a
    `synthesis`, whose `## Confidence` argues the value; a decision disposition belongs on an `adr`.
    A limitation parked in a trailing section does not travel with the citation this page exists to
    serve — a reader citing the definition reads it as settled.
  Discipline: a speculative or pre-commitment product idea declares `confidence: low` — the page
    shape is the same as a settled term's, so that field is the only thing telling a reader the
    idea is not yet vocabulary to cite as agreed.
  Required: `## Definition` — the section this type exists for; `None.` is not an answer there.
  Disposition: keep every header; "None." when empty.
  Substitute: {{TITLE}} {{DATE}} {{OWNER}} {{CONFIDENCE}}.
-->
